# kaal:claim:3441904-036

**Claim.** Ex post code based majoritarian rules generated by DAOs are superior to ex ante majoritarian default rules because they rest on more accurate real time information from the edge and decentralized feedback effects, and are not subject to the same information asymmetries.

**Type.** design  **Support.** argued

**Holds when.**

- DAOs with dynamic governance mechanisms allowing token holder votes on code

**Source quote.**

> Ex-post code-based majoritarian rules are superior to ex-ante majoritarian rules because they are based on more accurate real-time information from the edge and decentralized feedback effects.

**From.** Wulf A. Kaal, *Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance* (2019), V.1 Dynamic DAO Governance, page 32
